items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We bought the first arrangement Tad Dameron ever wrote, when he wrote -- when I was with Earl Hines.

ctx.x: Did you see him in New York here?
Oh, yes I saw him in New York. In fact, he used to come around to my house, him and Monk and Tad Dameron and Miles and all of the cats and that. In fact, --
